prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Atlanta after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but before I give a tailored list of specific firms to call, a couple quick questions so I recommend the best options for your situation:

- How serious were your injuries (minor, moderate, severe / long-term, hospitalization)?  
- Did the accident just happen or was it weeks/months ago?  
- Do you prefer a large national firm or a smaller local trial firm?  
- Any language preferences or mobility/transport needs?  

If you want a fast start, two well-known firms with established Atlanta presences you can call right away are:
- Morgan & Morgan — large national plaintiffs’ firm that handles high volumes of car-accident cases, with resources for medical liens, investigations, and appeals; typically works on contingency and offers free consults.
- The Cochran Firm Atlanta — prominent local plaintiff firm with trial experience in serious injury and wrongful-death cases and a reputation handling complex claims.

Why call multiple firms (what to look for)
- Experience with accidents like yours (catastrophic injury, whiplash, TBI, uninsured motorists, hit-and-run).  
- Trial experience — firms that go to court when insurers lowball settlements.  
- Financial resources — ability to front costs for medical liens, expert witnesses, and investigations.  
- Track record and local reputation — settlements/verdicts in Atlanta/Georgia.  
- Clear contingency-fee terms and whether they advance costs.  
- Responsiveness and communication style you prefer.

What to do right now (before/while calling lawyers)
1. Get and keep medical care records and bills.  
2. Preserve evidence: photos, dashcam, witness contacts, police report number.  
3. Don’t give recorded statements to the insurer without your attorney.  
4. Take notes of symptoms and missed work.  

Suggested questions to ask each firm on the call
- Do you handle car-accident cases in Atlanta/Georgia? Have you handled cases like mine?  
- What was a recent settlement/verdict you obtained for a similar injury?  
- Do you handle cases on contingency? What is your fee and what costs do you advance?  
- Who will handle my case (attorney name) and will you go to trial if necessary?  
- How do you communicate (phone/email/text), and who will be my point of contact?  
- Can you provide client references or online reviews?

If you want, I can:
- Create a vetted short list (6–8 firms) tailored to your injury severity and preferences (national vs boutique, trial focus, language needs).  
- Draft a short script you can use when you call.  
Tell me the answers to the quick questions above and I’ll put together a specific list of Atlanta firms to call and why each is a good fit.
